name: Dark beasts

unlocks.name: Need More Darkness
unlocks.notes: Number of dark beasts assigned is increased to 110-135.

variantInfo.name: Dark beast
notes: Requires 90 Slayer to kill and 90 combat to be assigned unless assignment difficulty has been disabled.
Uses crush melee and magic; Magic is only used as the first attack when attacked first or when the player is out of melee range.
Does not follow tolerance rules and remains permanently aggressive.
Dark beasts have a 60% elemental weakness to earth spells, but melee is the most effective task style.
Drops the dark bow at 1/512 and the death talisman at 1/128.

variantInfo.name: Night beast
notes: Superior slayer monster unlocked by purchasing Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points.
Night beasts are not aggressive, so the player normally triggers the first standard magic attack by attacking them.
Special attack pauses briefly, then uses three 3x3 magic attacks dealing one third of the player's current Hitpoints, rounded down.
The special cannot kill the player by itself below 3 Hitpoints, but the normal magic attack can still hit up to 8.
The simplest strategy is to keep Protect from Melee active, remain in melee range, and let the special attacks hit.

locationComparison.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Dark beasts killed here have a chance to drop crystal shards.
Requires Song of the Elves for Iorwerth Dungeon access.
Use a dwarf multicannon, but expect single-combat kills.

locationComparison.name: Mourner Tunnels
notes: Easily accessed with a Slayer ring after completing Mourning's End Part II.
Can also be reached through the Death Altar via the Abyss, or through Mourner Headquarters.
Use a dwarf multicannon, but expect single-combat kills.

taskNotes: Dark beasts require 90 Slayer, 90 combat to be assigned, and starting Mourning's End Part II.
They can be killed with Melee, Magic, or Ranged, but Melee is the most effective style.
Use high prayer bonus armour such as Proselyte armour or Sunfire fanatic armour with Protect from Melee.
Dark beasts are permanently aggressive and do not become tolerant, so they can be killed with low attention once set up.
They only use Magic as their first attack if attacked first by the player, or if they cannot attack with Melee.
Night beasts require attention because their special attack fires three 3x3 magic hits based on current Hitpoints.
Bring a herb sack and gem bag to maximise profit from herb and gem drops.
Iorwerth Dungeon dark beasts can drop crystal shards.
Dark beasts and Night beasts are the only monsters that drop the dark bow and death talisman.
Dark beasts are useful point-gaining tasks because their base assignment size is small; Need More Darkness extends the task to 110-135.
recommendedMethod: Use melee with Protect from Melee and high prayer bonus armour. Cannon in Iorwerth Dungeon for crystal shard chance or Mourner Tunnels for Slayer ring access; bring herb sack, gem bag, seed box, and prayer sustain.
